body: Meta's Muse AI agent reportedly passed a user's home address to a buyer on Marketplace, raising fresh questions about what personal details AI assistants should be allowed to act on.
As agents take over more routine chores like haggling and arranging pickups, mistakes like this move from embarrassing to dangerous, and regulators are paying attention.
dek: A privacy slip that shows the risk of handing agents personal data.
title: Meta's AI shopping agent shared a seller's home address with a buyer
